design.shadows: hairline 1px specular elevation, zero neon blur
design.motion: tactile 120ms-180ms ease, spring droplet physics on startup

must: Preserve 100% of DOM IDs for state and event dispatchers
Zero emojis in UI controls — use 1.5px stroke Lucide SVGs
65ch max-width reading measure for serif document canvas
Clean fail-safe offline mode if backend health check times out

decisions.decision: Integrated Liquid Glass Reveal as the in-app startup preloader on index.html with concurrent backend health check and smooth 550ms blur dissolution into workspace.
decisions.rationale: Gives the backend time to verify API key pools, OAuth tokens, and storage state while offering a bespoke high-craft tactile entry experience.

decisions.decision: Overhauled index.html with editorial typography (Newsreader serif prose, Inter controls, JetBrains Mono citations), laboratory flask branding, and refined accessibility attributes.
decisions.rationale: Eliminates generic AI template visuals and aligns with ex-Linear/Vercel warm minimalist aesthetic.

decisions.decision: Implemented intelligent auto-sort format collections engine for 3D Glass Folders partitioning PDFs, Google Docs/Word, Spreadsheets/CSV, Presentations/Slides, and Lab Notes/Markdown with live Google Drive synchronization.
decisions.rationale: Ensures incoming cloud files and starter documents automatically route into dedicated tactile format collections with format badges, Drive provenance badges, and quick filter pills.
